occurrences.text: And Zacharias said unto the angel, Whereby shall I know this? for I am an old man, and my wife well stricken in years.
That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience.
Yet for love’s sake I rather beseech thee, being such an one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
